verdict.rationale: Evidence only shows Thoropass exposing its own MCP server so external AI assistants can call Thoropass's tools (thoropass-docs-1, thoropass-docs-28, thoropass-probe-2) — this is Thoropass acting as the MCP server, not as an MCP client that plugs in and uses other MCP servers' tools. No evidence shows Thoropass's AI features (First Pass AI, Helpbot) can connect to external MCP servers to use their tools.
